envVars.PLUNK_API_KEY: Plunk secret key, the `sk_...` one from the Plunk dashboard under Project settings → API keys. It must be the secret key, not the public `pk_...` key, which cannot send. Read from apps/api/.env in local dev (saasaloy env, then pnpm env:setup) and from a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put PLUNK_API_KEY`) in production. Unset, every send through this provider throws EmailError("provider_error") before the request leaves the Worker.
envVars.PLUNK_API_URL: Base URL of the Plunk API, without a trailing path. Optional: it defaults to the hosted https://next-api.useplunk.com, and only a self-hosted Plunk instance needs to set it. It must use HTTPS (plain HTTP is accepted for localhost only) because the request carries PLUNK_API_KEY. Point it at a wrong host and every send fails with a 404 mapped to EmailError("provider_error").
